structure.name: Structural
structure.title: Structural system, load-combination outline, member check list

geotech.name: Geotechnical investigation

plumbing.name: Plumbing & drainage

hvac.name: HVAC

electrical.name: Electrical

fire-protect.name: Fire protection

steel.name: Steel structure
steel.title: Steel structural system, connections, anti-corrosion and coating outline

landscape.name: Landscape
landscape.title: Soft and hard landscape zoning, planting and paving principles

interior.name: Interior fit-out

port.name: Port & waterway

municipal.name: Municipal roads

bridge.name: Bridges
bridge.title: Bridge-type comparison, superstructure and substructure outline; nothing quantified without spans

tunnel.name: Tunnels
tunnel.title: Excavation and support, waterproofing, and monitoring-measurement outline

traffic.name: Traffic engineering
traffic.title: Traffic organisation, signs and markings, simulation criteria

design-coord.name: Design coordination
design-coord.title: Drawing review meetings, cross-discipline clashes, design-change rules

bim-coord.name: BIM coordination

bim-qto.name: BIM quantity take-off

bim-deliver.name: BIM delivery

plan-lookahead.name: Weekly/monthly plan

survey.name: Surveying
survey.title: Control network, setting-out and re-survey record rules; no coordinates unless the user gives them

dispatch.name: Site dispatch
dispatch.title: Daily reports, instructions issued, milestone tracking

safety-brief.name: Safety briefing
safety-brief.title: Technical safety briefing draft for the site engineer

quality.name: Quality
quality.title: Inspection lots, concealed-works acceptance, prevention of common defects; gives no pass verdict

env.name: Environment & tidy site
env.title: Rules for dust, spoil, wastewater and night works

emergency.name: Emergency

cost.name: Cost estimating

claim.name: Claims & budget adjustment

proc-plan.title: Client-nominated vs self-procured split, lead times, delivery milestones

proc-compare.name: Quotation comparison
proc-compare.title: Enquiry rules and comparison table; no prices without quotations

equip.name: Equipment management
equip.title: Arrival inspection, hire, maintenance, special-equipment certificates

pack-ship.name: Packing & container loading

material-site.name: Site materials

lab-mix.name: Mix design

lab-sample.name: Witnessed sampling

lab-record.name: Test register

finance-book.name: Accounting

supervision.name: Records & supervision
supervision.title: Acceptance record index and draft replies to supervision notices

hr-recruit.name: Recruitment
hr-recruit.title: Job descriptions, interview outlines; no salary bands unless the user gives them

hr-labor.name: Labour relations

hr-train.name: Training
hr-train.title: Skeleton for three-level safety induction and skills training plans

admin-office.name: Meetings & logistics
admin-office.title: Meetings, hosting visitors, travel, office supplies

it-app.name: System requirements
it-app.title: Skeleton for a business-system requirements specification

worker-brief.name: Plain-language crew talk
worker-brief.title: 3-minute pre-shift talk script for front-line workers

pm-daily.name: Daily site report
pm-daily.title: Visual progress, labour/plant/materials, safety and quality notes
